description: Header file defining the PTMCoreMLCompiler class, which provides methods for setting cache directory, compiling models, and loading models in a CoreML backend for PyTorch's JIT backend.

classes.name: PTMCoreMLCompiler
classes.description: Objective-C class providing static methods to manage CoreML model compilation and loading, including cache directory management and model instantiation.
